proposed_comments.title: Cancel deferred grid actions after direct selection

confidence.rationale: The pending action executes after layout and can restore an older navigation target after the user has directly selected a newer item. The converged one-line fix and focused grid tests validate the intended cancellation path.

proposed_comments.body:
### Cancel deferred grid actions after direct selection

**Severity:** `high`

Clearing only the remembered column leaves `_pendingGridAction` queued. If layout completes after a direct pointer or programmatic selection, that older deferred navigation can run and overwrite the newer selection. Cancel the full pending grid state when the selection did not originate from grid navigation.

```suggestion
            CancelPendingGridActions();
```
